posts.title: Minato Riverside Offices handed over
posts.excerpt: Nine floors, fourteen months, and the keys four days early.
posts.content:
On Friday we handed over the Minato Riverside Offices, a nine-floor concrete office building beside the river, four days ahead of the contract date.

The building was poured floor by floor with recycled aggregate in the lower slabs, and 70 per cent of the work went to firms based within 50 kilometres. Our aftercare team will be back for the first inspection next autumn.

posts.title: How we plan every crane lift
posts.excerpt: A lift plan, a named supervisor and a hold point before every heavy load.
posts.content:
Since 2019 every crane lift on our sites has a written lift plan: the load, the path, the exclusion zone and the name of the supervisor who signs it off.

Heavy or unusual lifts have a hold point: work stops until the site manager has checked the ground, the weather and the radio links. It costs us about ten minutes per lift, and our incident rate has fallen every year since.

posts.title: Open site day at Hinode Apartments
posts.excerpt: Neighbours and future residents can walk the frame on Saturday morning.
posts.content:
On Saturday at 10:00 we open the Hinode Apartments site to neighbours and future residents. Hard hats and boots are provided; the tour takes about an hour.

You will see the concrete frame, a show flat and the base isolation pads that will carry the building. Children over twelve are welcome with an adult.
